name: Shadow Of The Cursed Realm
detailed_description:
Shadow of the Cursed Realm is a gripping first-person psychological horror experience that blends atmospheric exploration, mind-bending puzzles, and relentless terror. Step into a forsaken world where reality twists into a nightmare, and unseen horrors stalk the shadows.

Setting and Atmosphere:

  • Cursed Realm: Enter a decaying land consumed by darkness, where every corner hides a sinister secret. The game’s eerie landscapes, unsettling ruins, and oppressive atmosphere will keep you on edge.

  • Psychological Horror: Hallucinations and eerie whispers blur the line between what’s real and what’s not, creating an immersive and unsettling experience.

Story and Character:

  • Protagonist’s Descent: You are drawn into a cursed mystery, uncovering the tragic past of those who came before you. As you piece together the story, the horrors around you intensify.

  • A Mind Under Siege: Encounter disturbing visions and cryptic messages that force you to question your own sanity.

Gameplay:

  • Linear Narrative Journey: A carefully structured story leads players through spine-chilling encounters, unexpected twists, and horrifying revelations.

  • Stealth and Survival: Evade nightmarish entities using the environment to your advantage. Running is sometimes your only option.

  • Puzzle Solving: Unlock secrets by deciphering cryptic symbols, ancient texts, and environmental clues.

Challenges:

  • Relentless Entities: Supernatural forces lurk in the darkness, adapting to your actions and hunting you relentlessly.

  • Unpredictable Events: The game’s AI-driven scares and hallucinations ensure no two playthroughs are the same.

Immersive Design:

  • Atmospheric Visuals and Sound: Dynamic lighting, haunting soundscapes, and hyper-detailed environments create a truly terrifying world.

  • Heart-Pounding Audio Design: Every distant whisper and unseen movement adds to the tension.

Progression:

  • Unravel the Curse: Collect fragments of the past, decode hidden messages, and uncover the truth behind the nightmare.

  • Dynamic Fear System: The game responds to your choices and fears, increasing psychological tension over time.

Replayability:

  • Multiple Endings: The choices you make impact the story, leading to different outcomes and hidden paths.

  • Secrets to Uncover: Missed clues and hidden details encourage multiple playthroughs to fully understand the lore.

short_description: Shadow of the Cursed Realm is a first-person horror adventure where reality twists into nightmares. Solve puzzles, survive lurking horrors, and uncover dark secrets in a cursed land. Will you escape or be consumed?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7 6700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 with 6GB VRAM ／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti with 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500 ／ Intel Core i7 9700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT with 8 GB VRAM／ NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 with 8 GB VRAM / INTEL Arc A750 with 8 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
